apscp: Decision Support Tool for the Antarctic Peninsula

Source: R/package.R
apscp.Rd

Interactive decision support tool to navigate management options for the Antarctic Peninsula. The tool identifies priority areas for implementing policies for conservation, tourism, and scientific research. To achieve this, it leverages data (Lee et al. 2025) and multi-objective optimization techniques through the prioritizr package (Hanson et al. 2025; https://prioritizr.net). Although default parameters are specified based on stakeholder surveys, users can calibrate weights and representation targets to fine tune optimization procedures according to their own preferences. Optimization procedures can be performed with the Gurobi (https://www.gurobi.com/) or CBC (via the rcbc package, https://github.com/dirkschumacher/rcbc) exact algorithm solvers.

References

Hanson JO, Schuster R, Strimas‐Mackey M, Morrell N, Edwards BPM, Arcese P, Bennett JR, Possingham HP (2024) Systematic conservation prioritization with the prioritizr R package. Conservation Biology, 39: e14376.

Lee JR, Shaw JD, Ropert-Coudert Y, Terauds A, Chown SL (2024) Conservation features of the terrestrial Antarctic Peninsula. Ambio, 53:1037–1049.
